items.title: Rex's Dino Store
items.excerpt: Museum: Rex's Dino Store Located just before the turnstiles in the Grand Army Plaza subway station at the north end of Brooklyn's Prospect Park is this former newsstand which is now operated by a dinosaur. The density of dinosaur puns is exceptional. Tags: art, new-york
items.why_it_matters: Personal post about a dinosaur-themed former newsstand in a Brooklyn subway station. Unrelated to software delivery.

AINews’ website lets you search all past issues. As a reminder, AINews is now a section of Latent Space.
